title: Scalable Diffusion Models with Transformers
blurb: Replaced the diffusion U-Net with a plain transformer over latent patches and showed sample quality improves steadily with compute.
intro: DiT patchifies a latent like a ViT, runs transformer blocks over the tokens and unpatchifies the output into a noise prediction and a variance. The timestep and class label condition every block through adaptive LayerNorm: they regress a shift, a scale and a residual gate per sublayer, initialised so each block starts as the identity. The steps build patchification, the timestep embedding, one adaLN-Zero block and classifier-free guidance; the capstone is the full forward pass from latent to output.

steps.name: Classifier-free guidance
steps.note: DiT's best results use guidance with a null class label.
